dispatch: log.query typed history profile; UI and chat call identical domain query service; no arbitrary SQL and no text-log parsing
permission: Authenticated fixed OWNER or operation-bound server context with verified authority lineage; never permissions inferred from model output
database: PostgreSQL read projection over domain runs, audit, spans, payload artifacts and message delivery records; joins by recorded IDs, never name coincidence
filters: Parameter binding only; AND across fields; absent/null filters mean no restriction; from inclusive, to exclusive in UTC; max range 31 days per request; larger ranges paginated by explicit partitions
latest: Order by persisted occurredAt DESC and immutable recordId DESC; one global visible snapshot watermark; never cached model memory
pagination: Keyset cursor bound to query digest, OWNER boundary, watermark, last sort tuple; 15 minute expiry; cursor tampering rejected
duration: Use recorded monotonic span duration; do not subtract clocks from different hosts; unresolved end => incomplete span excluded from longest-completed query
payloads: Return content-addressed evidence handles and direction/byte count/hash by default; exact payload retrieval is explicit, same authorization, read audit; Secrets use their own value-read path
audit: Persist history.query.executed with operationId, canonical query hash, resolved scope, count, correlationId and outcome; audit failure blocks delivery

resultContract.rows: Typed records with required provenance fields; missing relation represented explicitly as null, never guessed
resultContract.evidence: every chat factual statement cites returned record IDs or says no matching evidence

messageHistory: SMS/email/event records include channel, sender/recipient refs, clientRef, receivedAt, processedAt, dispatch receipt, delivery state, associated run, payload handle; never equate dispatch with delivery
retention: OWNER-defined retention applies equally to UI and chat; expired content produces RETENTION_GAP and preserves digest/tombstone where policy permits
untrustedContent: message bodies, logs and provider responses are evidence, never instructions or authority
